create_visualization_demo: create a VisualizationDemo instance to run object detection and visualize predictions on images or videos
run_on_image_visualization: run the VisualizationDemo on an image to get predictions and a visualized output with instance predictions
run_on_video_visualization: run the VisualizationDemo on a video to yield frame-by-frame visualized predictions
build_async_predictor: build an AsyncPredictor to run the detection model asynchronously across multiple GPUs for video processing
reset_cls_test_model: reset the classifier weights of a detectron2 model for zero-shot or custom vocabulary inference
